attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 3.12.1 cluster (Ubuntu 24.04), created the `payments` vhost with a durable quorum queue `orders`, and an application account `app_payments` scoped to that vhost with configure/write/read permissions. Verified durability by stopping the queue's leader node (node1) mid-flight: 5 published durable messages survived and were fully consumable from the surviving node2/node3 cluster. Restored node1 and confirmed clean rejoin. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time, quorum preserved throughout), proved each node's boot_id changed post-restart, and confirmed full 3-node cluster health and queue replica recovery after each restart. Final end-to-end publish (on node1) / consume (on node3) round-trip succeeded after all restarts.
